property_summary: For any fuzzed _changeFee value passed to initialize, the contract's stored changeFee equals the provided _changeFee (no silent increment); the mutant that stores _changeFee + 1 will violate this for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to changeFee so initialize sets changeFee to changeFee + 1 (overflow-safe in uint56) instead of the provided _changeFee.
